name: spatial_jaccard_similarity
decomposition_rationale: Provides specialized threshold-based Jaccard similarity comparison and duplicate filtering over multiple sets.

nodes.name: jaccard_similarity_threshold
nodes.semantic_role: Compute pairwise Jaccard similarities and filter pairs below a threshold.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Pairwise Jaccard comparisons scale quadratically with the number of sets N and linearly with average set size M.
